         (these don't navigate — instead they toggle their submenu open)

         submenu so the parent category page is still reachable on mobile

        ts.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }

    btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        setOpen(!ts.classList.contains('is-open'));
    });

    // Close on outside click.
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!ts.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
        if (ts.contains(e.target)) return;

            ['/software',             'gear',    'software'],
            ['movie-digital-downloads','film',   'movie'],
            ['/movie',                'film',    'movie'],
            ['retail-keys',           'box',     'retail']
        ];
        function iconFor(href) {
            var h = (href || '').toLowerCase();
            for (var p = 0; p < PLATFORM_MAP.length; p++) {
                if (h.indexOf(PLATFORM_MAP[p][0]) !== -1) {
                    return { svg: ICONS[PLATFORM_MAP[p][1]], cls: PLATFORM_MAP[p][2] };
                }
            }
            return null;
        }
        var subLinks = catsRoot.querySelectorAll(':scope > li > ul > li > a');
        for (var n = 0; n < subLinks.length; n++) {
            var sa = subLinks[n];
            if (sa.querySelector('.top-strip__cat-icon')) continue;     // idempotent
            var ic = iconFor(sa.getAttribute('href'));
            if (!ic) continue;
            var iconWrap = document.createElement('span');
            iconWrap.className = 'top-strip__cat-icon top-strip__cat-icon--' + ic.cls;
            iconWrap.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            iconWrap.innerHTML = ic.svg;
            sa.insertBefore(iconWrap, sa.firstChild);
            // Also tag the parent <li> so we can colour the row's left accent
            var liEl = sa.parentElement;
            if (liEl) liEl.classList.add('top-strip__cats-sub--' + ic.cls);
        }
    }

    // ---------- Sign-out relocation (mobile only) ----------
    // On mobile, lift the Sign-in/out <li> out of #topStripNav and pin it
    // to the absolute bottom of the drawer (below the language footer) so
    // it reads as the final, distinct action. On desktop the <li> stays in
    // its original position inside the pill bar. Resize-aware so resizing
    // a desktop window down to mobile (and back) restores the right state.
    var loginLink = document.getElementById('login-link');
    var signOutLi = loginLink && loginLink.closest('li');
    var container = ts.querySelector(':scope > .container-fluid');
    var nav       = document.getElementById('topStripNav');
    if (signOutLi && container && nav) {
        var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
        function syncSignOutLocation(matches) {
            if (matches) {
                // Move to its own ul at the absolute bottom of the drawer.
                var bottomWrap = container.querySelector(':scope > .top-strip__signout-mobile');
                if (!bottomWrap) {
                    bottomWrap = document.createElement('ul');
                    bottomWrap.className = 'top-strip__signout-mobile';
                    container.appendChild(bottomWrap);
                }
                if (signOutLi.parentNode !== bottomWrap) {
                    bottomWrap.appendChild(signOutLi);
                }
            } else {
                // Desktop: restore to end of #topStripNav.
                if (signOutLi.parentNode !== nav) {
                    nav.appendChild(signOutLi);
                }
                var empty = container.querySelector(':scope > .top-strip__signout-mobile');
                if (empty && !empty.children.length) empty.parentNode.removeChild(empty);
            }
        }
        // matchMedia: modern browsers prefer addEventListener('change'); older
        // Safari only supports addListener. Cover both.
        if (mq.addEventListener) {
            mq.addEventListener('change', function (e) { syncSignOutLocation(e.matches); });
        } else if (mq.addListener) {
            mq.addListener(function (e) { syncSignOutLocation(e.matches); });
        }
        syncSignOutLocation(mq.matches);
    }

    // ---------- Account + AutoKey quick links (mobile drawer) ----------
    // Those two sit in #topStripNav, which renders BELOW the category
    // accordion on mobile. Mirror them as two big tiles at the very top of
    // the drawer; cjs-mobile.css shows the tiles and hides the originals on
    // mobile only, so the desktop pill bar is untouched. Labels/hrefs are read
    // from the real links so the %%LNG_%% strings stay localised.
    var mbar = ts.querySelector('.top-strip__mobile-bar');
    if (mbar && container && !container.querySelector(':scope > .top-strip__quick')) {
        var QUICK = [
            ['.top-strip__nav-account', 'top-strip__quick-account', '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/></svg>'],
            ['.top-strip__nav-autokey', 'top-strip__quick-autokey', '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="15" r="4"/><path d="M10.8 12.2 21 2"/><path d="M17 6l3 3"/><path d="M14 9l3 3"/></svg>']
        ];
        var quick = document.createElement('div');
        quick.className = 'top-strip__quick';
        for (var q = 0; q < QUICK.length; q++) {
            var srcLi = nav && nav.querySelector(QUICK[q][0]);
            var srcA  = srcLi && srcLi.querySelector('a');
            // Respect the server-side hide (eg account options switched off).
            if (!srcA || srcLi.style.display === 'none') continue;
            var tile = document.createElement('a');
            tile.className = 'top-strip__quick-link ' + QUICK[q][1];
            tile.href = srcA.getAttribute('href');
            tile.innerHTML = QUICK[q][2] + '<span></span>';
            tile.lastChild.textContent = (srcA.textContent || '').trim();
            quick.appendChild(tile);
        }
        if (quick.children.length) {
            container.insertBefore(quick, mbar.nextSibling);
        }
    }

    // Close when any link inside the panel is clicked so the page can navigate cleanly,
    // EXCEPT for the cart icon and the accordion parent anchors (which just expand).
    ts.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a');
        if (!a || !ts.contains(a)) return;
        if (a.classList.contains('top-strip__cart-mobile')) return;
        // Accordion parents: a sits inside <li.HasSubMenu> whose parent ul is .top-strip__cats
        var parentLi = a.parentElement;
        if (parentLi && parentLi.classList.contains('HasSubMenu')
                && a.closest('ul') && a.closest('ul').id === 'topStripCats') {
            return;
        }
        setOpen(false);
    });

    // (Removed) Movie Marketplace / Price Drops nav relocation. Those two items
    // are now emitted in their final position SERVER-SIDE — right after the
    // "Products" item — by includes/display/PagesMenu.php. Repositioning them in
    // JS on DOMContentLoaded made the menu visibly reorder on every page load.
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    if (window.__cjsHomeSpinnerInit) return;
    window.__cjsHomeSpinnerInit = true;

    var headlinePool = [
        "Don't know where to start?",
        "Feeling indecisive? Let fate pick.",
        "Spin it. Summon a game.",
        "Let the wheel choose your next adventure.",
        "Too many games? Let the wheel decide."
    ];

    function rand(arr) { return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]; }

    function ready(fn) {
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
        } else { fn(); }
    }

    // Reveal the spinner only if the cart is confirmed empty. We rely on
    // /ajax/user-state.php to set window.CJS_CartItems and dispatch
    // 'cjs:cart-state' (see ajax-currency-and-user-management.js).
    function maybeReveal(root) {
        if (typeof window.CJS_CartItems === 'number' && window.CJS_CartItems === 0) {
            hydrateAndShow(root);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function hydrateAndShow(root) {
        if (root.dataset.cjsHydrated === '1') {
            root.hidden = false;
            return;
        }
        root.dataset.cjsHydrated = '1';

        // Pick a random headline
        var titleEl = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-home-spinner-title]');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = rand(headlinePool);

        // Read the trending product cards rendered elsewhere on the page
        var trendingItems = document.querySelectorAll(
            '#coreyWeeklyBestsellers .item, .product-slide .item'
        );
        if (!trendingItems.length) {
            // No trending data — keep hidden, nothing to spin
            return;
        }

        // Wheel only summons Steam or Xbox titles, and never Game Pass
        // Ultimate (subscription bundle, not a discrete game).
        var ALLOW_PLATFORM = /\b(steam|xbox)\b/i;
        var BLOCKLIST     = /\bgame\s*pass\s+ultimate\b/i;

        var products = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < trendingItems.length; i++) {
            var item = trendingItems[i];
            var titleA = item.querySelector('.product-box-title a, a.product-box-title');
            var priceEl = item.querySelector('.product-box-price');
            var thumb = item.querySelector('.item-image-thumb');
            if (!titleA || !thumb) continue;

            var titleText = titleA.textContent.trim();
            if (!ALLOW_PLATFORM.test(titleText)) continue;
            if (BLOCKLIST.test(titleText)) continue;

            var bg = thumb.getAttribute('style') || '';
            var m = bg.match(/url\(([^)]+)\)/);
            var imgUrl = m ? m[1].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '') : '';

            products.push({
                title: titleText,
                url:   titleA.getAttribute('href'),
                img:   imgUrl,
                price: priceEl ? priceEl.textContent.trim() : ''
            });
        }

        if (products.length < 4) {
            return; // not enough data to be interesting — stay hidden
        }

        // Pick 8 distinct products for the wheel (or pad-by-cycling if <8)
        var pool = products.slice();
        for (var j = pool.length - 1; j > 0; j--) {
            var k = Math.floor(Math.random() * (j + 1));
            var tmp = pool[j]; pool[j] = pool[k]; pool[k] = tmp;
        }
        var wedgeProducts = [];
        for (var w = 0; w < 8; w++) {
            wedgeProducts.push(pool[w % pool.length]);
        }

        var wheel = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-wheel]');
        if (!wheel) return;
        wheel.innerHTML = '';
        for (var n = 0; n < 8; n++) {
            var t = document.createElement('div');
            t.className = 'cjs-wedge-thumb';
            t.style.setProperty('--i', n);
            if (wedgeProducts[n].img) {
                t.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + wedgeProducts[n].img + ')';
            }
            t.title = wedgeProducts[n].title;
            wheel.appendChild(t);
        }

        var spinBtn = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-spin]');
        var spinAgain = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-spin-again]');
        var resultEl = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-result]');
        var resultImg = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-result-img]');
        var resultTitle = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-result-title]');
        var resultPrice = root.querySelector('[data-cjs-result-price]');
        var resultLinks = root.querySelectorAll('[data-cjs-result-link]');

        var totalRotation = 0;
        var isSpinning = false;

        function spin() {
            if (isSpinning) return;
            isSpinning = true;
            if (resultEl) resultEl.hidden = true;
            if (spinBtn) spinBtn.disabled = true;

            var winnerIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
            var winnerCentreDeg = winnerIndex * 45 + 22.5;
            var jitter = (Math.random() * 30) - 15;
            totalRotation += 360 * 5 + (360 - winnerCentreDeg) + jitter;

            wheel.classList.add('is-spinning');
            wheel.style.transform = 'rotate(' + totalRotation + 'deg)';

            setTimeout(function () {
                isSpinning = false;
                if (spinBtn) spinBtn.disabled = false;
                showResult(wedgeProducts[winnerIndex]);
            }, 4500);
        }

        function showResult(p) {
            if (!resultEl || !p) return;
            if (resultImg) {
                resultImg.src = p.img || '';
                resultImg.alt = p.title || '';
            }
            if (resultTitle) resultTitle.textContent = p.title || '';
            if (resultPrice) resultPrice.textContent = p.price || '';
            for (var i = 0; i < resultLinks.length; i++) {
                resultLinks[i].setAttribute('href', p.url || '#');
            }
            resultEl.hidden = false;
            try { resultEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' }); } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (spinBtn)   spinBtn.addEventListener('click', spin);
        if (spinAgain) spinAgain.addEventListener('click', spin);

        // Reveal once the wheel is built
        root.hidden = false;
    }

    ready(function () {
        var root = document.querySelector('[data-cjs-home-spinner]');
        if (!root) return;

        // If user-state has already resolved, react immediately
        if (maybeReveal(root)) return;

        // Otherwise wait for the cart-state event from
        // /javascript/ajax-currency-and-user-management.js
        document.addEventListener('cjs:cart-state', function (ev) {
            var count = (ev && ev.detail && typeof ev.detail.count === 'number') ? ev.detail.count : null;
            if (count === 0) { hydrateAndShow(root); }
        }, { once: false });
    });
})();

                   both panels self-contained and doesn't disturb the cached

                function relocate() {

					window.cjsProductSlideOpts = {
					// product slide starts
							autoPlay: 5000, //Set AutoPlay to 5 seconds
							loop:true,
							autoplay:false,
							autoplayTimeout:9000,
							autoplayHoverPause:true,
							responsiveClass:true,
							responsive:{
									// Phone — show ONE full-width card. The previous
									// 3-up was unreadable: titles clipped, prices
									// overlapped the View hint.
									0:{
											items:1,
											nav:true,
											margin:8
									},
									// Large phone / phablet — two cards fit comfortably
									480:{
											items:2,
											nav:true,
											margin:10
									},
									// Tablet — three cards
									768:{
											items:3,
											nav:true,
											margin:10
									},
									// Small desktop
									1000:{
											items:5,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									},
									// Large desktop
									1500:{
											items:8,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									}
							}
				 };
					j(".product-slide").owlCarousel(window.cjsProductSlideOpts); // product slide ends
					j(".all-time-slide").owlCarousel({
					// product slide starts
							autoPlay: 5000, //Set AutoPlay to 5 seconds
							loop:true,
							autoplay:false,
							autoplayTimeout:9000,
							autoplayHoverPause:true,
							responsiveClass:true,
							responsive:{
									0:{
											items:3,
											nav:true
									},
									600:{
											items:3,
											nav:false
									},
									1000:{
											items:5,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									},
                                                                        1500:{
											items:8,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									}
							}
				 }); // product slide ends

					j(".product-latest-slide").owlCarousel({
					// product slide starts for latest orders
							autoPlay: 5000, //Set AutoPlay to 5 seconds
							// loop:false everywhere. The desktop breakpoints (1000/1500)
							// already set loop:false and work; on mobile widths the
							// slider used to inherit the old top-level loop:true, and
							// Owl's loop/clone init silently failed at the narrow
							// items:2 breakpoint — leaving the carousel without its
							// .owl-loaded class, which owl.carousel.css keeps as
							// display:none. That's why "Latest Sales" was blank on
							// mobile but appeared in desktop view. 33 items, so no loop
							// needed anyway.
							loop:false,
							autoplay:false,
							autoplayTimeout:9000,
							autoplayHoverPause:true,
							responsiveClass:true,
							responsive:{
									0:{
											items:2,
											nav:true
									},
									600:{
											items:3,
											nav:false
									},
									1000:{
											items:5,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									},
                                                                        1500:{
											items:7,
											nav:true,
											loop:false
									}
							}
				 }); 

				j(".humberger-icon").click(function(){// humberger icon starts
							j("header nav").animate({"left": "0px"}, "slow");
							j('body').css('overflow', 'hidden');
							j(".overlay-nav").show(); // show
				});	 
				j(".overlay-nav,.close-nav-icon").click(function(){
						j("header nav").animate({"left": "-350px"}, "slow");
						j('body').css('overflow', 'auto');
						j(".overlay-nav").hide();// hide
				}); // humberger icon ends
				
    });
</script>
